question: Who among the following gave the concept of ‘paradox of thrift’?
solution:
The correct answer is __John Maynard Keynes__.

__
 
• **John Maynard Keynes gave the concept of the ‘paradox of thrift’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

Paradox of Thrift :

__
 
• This concept talks about the ill effects of the personal savings of an individual on the economy.
 
• According to Keynes, During a recession in the economy, people tend to save more money as deposits rather than spending it.
 
• It leads to a decrease in aggregate demand and production falls, due to which the wages are reduced to counterbalance the fall in production.
 
• Hence the amounts of money available in the hands of people decrease and ultimately their savings also fall.
 
• In turn, the amount of money available to banks to lend as loans will decrease and the economy will go into a deeper recession.
 
• The concept is a paradox because according to it the savings of people will decrease because of the increase in their savings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to Adam Smith, the tax paid by an individual should not be arbitrary but it should be certain because the tax paid by an individual has no connection with the benefit received by him/her.
 
• In order to guide the taxing authority, Adam Smith laid down four principles which are also known as the Canons of taxation:
 
 
• Canon of Equality
 
• Canon of Certainty
 
• Canon of Convenience
 
• Canon of Economy
 
 
 
• Later, other economists also extended the list of Canons by Adam Smith:
 
 
• Canon of Productivity
 
• Canon of Elasticity
 
• Canon of Simplicity
 
• Canon of Variety
 
• Canon of Flexibility
